facts: Parties: Netherby Capital LLP (Buyer), Bellhaven Medical Ltd (Seller); the Company is Quayside Engineering Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 26 March 2027; Closing is scheduled for 22 June 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 8.4 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $23,750,000. The Purchase Price is $190,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Arden Foods Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $1,200,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Yarrow Pharma plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
